Approved evidence

DataPure

org.datapure

Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The complete retained root, resources/case-study index and contact texts were actually read in this new metadata phase. They support one commercial DataPure operating brand combining AI and real-time human-in-the-loop edge-case/LLM validation with custom data gathering and customer discovery/demo offers. Supplier-hosted named Podchaser and Bossa Nova Robotics testimonials describe database/ad-detection and project-support relationships, while the resources index describes human-validated image/retail/annotation workflows and anonymous case summaries. These are provider-hosted disclosures, not independently confirmed customer contracts or measured outcomes. Legal contracting entity, registration and parent ownership remain unknown; one brand is retained without inventing a parent relationship. Recruitment, specialist credentials, QA acceptance thresholds, active workforce, revenue and the advertised 98%+ accuracy or rapid-turnaround claims are not independently verified. No applicable executed client contract or dataset-specific consent, copyright or upstream web-data rights were inspected. This scoped available-primary capability/process/identity/limits audit supports supplier classification conditional on separate coordinator commercial/group metadata acceptance and import of the exact four already-three-role-passed own-subject facts. It creates no new scientific wording or PASS, blanket data-rights/security assurance or all-source-function closure.
